name: Moonwarden the Elder
summary: At the Crossroads, Moonwarden the Elder receives travelers beneath a beam of light. During the Lunar Festival, people honor ancestral spirits and seek his wisdom and directions to elders across Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Celestial Presence in the Barrens
sections.body: At the Crossroads, a column of light falls around Elder Moonwarden. He is one of the ancient spirits honored during the Lunar Festival, when mortals set aside their conflicts to seek the wisdom of generations past.

sections.title: Guidance to the Ancestors
sections.body: Elder Moonwarden looks to the stars for answers to earthly mysteries. He offers ancestral blessings and directs seekers to other elders across Kalimdor, including Elder Bloodhoof, Elder High Mountain, Elder Morningdew, and Elder Runetotem.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Moonwarden?
faq.answer: Elder Moonwarden stands at the Crossroads in the Barrens, beneath a bright column of starlight.

faq.q: What is the purpose of visiting Elder Moonwarden?
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, travelers honor ancestral spirits, receive tokens of ancestry, and seek directions to other elders.

faq.q: Which other elders can Moonwarden direct you to?
faq.answer: Elder Moonwarden can direct you to Elder Bloodhoof, Elder High Mountain, Elder Morningdew, and Elder Runetotem.

faq.q: Can Alliance adventurers speak with Elder Moonwarden?
faq.answer: Alliance travelers can speak with Elder Moonwarden, though he stands in the Horde settlement of the Crossroads, where local guards make the visit dangerous.

faq.q: Why is there a beam of light shining on Elder Moonwarden?
faq.answer: The beam of light marks Elder Moonwarden's connection to the stars and the ancestral realm during the Lunar Festival.

faq.q: What does Elder Moonwarden say about the stars?
faq.answer: Elder Moonwarden says the stars hold answers to earthly mysteries, and asks whether the wise and lucky might look up and find truth.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you must enter the Horde settlement of the Crossroads to visit Elder Moonwarden, where the guards make the journey perilous.
As a Horde traveler crossing central Kalimdor, you can conveniently honor Elder Moonwarden as part of the Lunar Festival tradition.
As a druid, you may find Elder Moonwarden's focus on celestial mysteries and starry portents familiar through your attunement to nature and lunar cycles.
